tara (AE): Heads-up: LumaHealth asked for a 3-week POC next Monday. They need a single committed monthly price, throughput sizing for ~8k peak (avg ~600 tokens), BYOK/HSM clarity, and log retention for 12 months.

ken (SE): They explicitly said no burst-only pricing. Finance wants predictable monthly commitment and an AZ-eviction fallback.

viv (Solutions): Initial thumb: Dedicated eu-west-1 recommended. For 8k@600t, propose reserved pool = 3 GPUs (A40-class equiv) with autoscale headroom to 5. If they accept q8 quantization, 2 reserved could work but mixed workloads complicate it.

tara (AE): Can we get three clean options for procurement: (1) 3 reserved baseline, (2) 5 reserved buffer, (3) 2 reserved + burst credits? Need monthly numbers + p99 caveats.

viv (Solutions): Rough bullets: 3 reserved = predictable cost, solid p99. 5 reserved = ~+45% cost, lowers queuing on sustained spikes. 2+burst = ~-20% cost but higher p99 risk. Will run exact token-costs and attach to ticket.

anya (Security): BYOK/HSM: we support CMK + partner HSM wrapping as an enterprise add-on. Dedicated + enterprise pack supports 12mo logs; hosted default is 90d. HSM/BYOK requires legal addendum and procurement signoff.

ken (SE): Ops config to include in doc: autoscale min=3 target_util=0.68 max=5 cooldown=120s and a KV prewarm job. Also need AZ-fallback runbook (cross-AZ standby + degrade-to-smaller-variant).

viv (Solutions): I'll include this autoscale YAML and a short smoke test (ramp 0->8k rps over 12m) capturing p50/p95/p99 and token_cost.csv. Example: `loadgen --target 8000 --ramp 720 --payload=chat_600.json --report=token_cost.csv`.

tara (AE): timeline: questionnaire answers by Fri EOD, pricing sheet with three options by Mon, infra deploy Tue. Can we meet that?

viv (Solutions): yes. I'll open a ticket with numbers, autoscale snippets, and smoke test.

ops_bot: created ticket SRV-19876 "LumaHealth POC: reserved pricing + HSM addendum" assigned to viv, due 2026-04-04. :white_check_mark:

tara (AE): great — please call out quantized vs FP pricing bins and include a short note about measuring cost-per-1k-responses during the POC.

viv (Solutions): will add quantized multipliers (q8 x1.6) and a daily cost digest. End of thread.
